content: Machcho Anjji Yeddidi Hara Eko Gishshas Imettida Woga
Issi asi machcho ekki simmidaappe guye izi bolla issi iita miish demmidi izo ixxiko izo anjji yeddishe izis waraqata xaafi immidi yeddo.
Izasoppe kezada hara azina gelikko,
he nam7anththo azinaykka izo dosontta ixxidi izis waraqata xaafi immidi ba sooppe izo kessi yeddiko, woykko izo ekkida he nam7anththo azinazi hayqqiko;
iza tunida gishshas koyro anjji yeddida azinazi nam7anththo izo zaaridi ekkofo; hessi GODAA matan ixettidayssa; qasse intteka GODAA intte Xoossay inttes immida biittan hayssa mala nagara ooththofte.
Dumma Dumma Wogata
Mata wode machcho ekkida asi olas booppo; hara deexo oosokka iza oosisopite. Issi layththi aadhdhana gakkanaas bason gam7idi bananne ba ekkida machchiyo ufaysso.
Neni issaades miishshe tal7e tal7ashe kath gaacciza woxa woykko woxa mayde izappe oyththo ekkofa. Hessaththo oosoy asa shemppo oysora gina.
Ba isha gidida Isra7eele asaa garsafe dhanka barsi efidi baas aylle ooththizay woykko hara asas aylleteththas aaththi bayzizaadey oonikka hayqo. Hessaththo histtidi iita ooso intte giddofe diggite.
Issaafe issaan aadhdhiza galba hargefe keehi naagettite; tani istta azazida mala Lewe qommo gidida qeeseti inttes immiza wogata lo7eththi naagite.
Intte Gibxeppe kezi yishin GODAA intte Xoossi Maarami bolla ooththidayssa yuushshi qopite.
Neni issaades issi miishshe tal7e immashe izi nena oyththiza miish ekkanaas izaade soo geloppa.
Neni karen dishin izaadey ba kushera nees oyso eho.
Izaadey manqo gidikko ne oyso ekkada iza afala ne soon ayssofa.
Izi may7i aqana mala arshey wullontta dishin izas zaara; izikka nena galatana; hessi nees GODAA ne Xoossaa achchan xilloteththan qoodettana.
Ne bagga gidida Isra7eele asaappe gidiin woykko hara dereppe bete yiidi metotida manqo asi nees ooththiko, izaade wolqqa coo mela nees go7ettofa.
Izi hach ooththidayssa hach ekkanaas minththi koyza gishshas arshey wullontta dishin qanxxa; histtontta aggiko metotanchchay neeppe dendoyssan GODAAS waassiko nees nagara gidana.
Nayti moorida mooron yelidayti, qasse yelidayti moorida mooron istta nayti hayqon qaxxayettanaas bessenna; issoy issoy ba moorida mooroza gishshas hayqon qaxxayetto.
Hara biitta asatassinne yi7o naytas pirda geellasoppa; am7ey may7o iza tal7e ekkida miishsha gishshas gaada oyso ekkofa.
Kase intte Gibxe biittan aylleteththan de7idayssanne intte GODAA Xoossay inttena wozzi kessidayssa yuushshi qopite; tanikka hayta ha azazota inttes immizay hessassa.

Neni maxida kaththaa shiishshiin baletti guye attida mirqqey diikko iza ekkanaas guye simmofa; hessa hara biittafe yida bete asatas, yi7otassinne am7etas heen aggaaga. Ne hessaththo ooththiko ne ooththiza ooso ubbaan GODAA ne Xoossay nena anjjana.
Neni wogara miththa ayfe issito maxidaappe guye geedon attidayssa ekkanaas nam7anththo guye simmofa. Hessa hara biittafe bete yidaytas, yi7o naytassinne am7etas aggaaga.
Neni woyne miththa ayfe issito maxidaappe guye geedon attidayssa ekkanaas nam7anththo guye simmofa; hessa hara biittafe bete yidaytas, yi7o naytassinne am7etas aggaaga.
Nekka kase Gibxe biittan aylle gididayssa baloppa; tanikka hayta ha azazota inttes immizay hessassa.
